title: Plasma Globe Lighthouse
description: A large plasma globe with a glowing red central electrode and branching pink, purple and yellow electrical tendrils sits on a tiled floor, casting colorful reflections. In the background, a dark lighthouse stands before a massive glowing green celestial body under a stormy night sky with yellow lightning.
prompt: Surreal night scene featuring a large plasma globe in the foreground with bright pink and purple electrical tendrils radiating from a glowing red core, casting vibrant reflections on a tiled floor. A dark silhouette of a lighthouse stands behind it against a massive luminous green planet or moon in a dark stormy sky filled with yellow branching lightning.
